title: GROUP command calls list_groups() on every GROUP request
description: O(G) REPEATED FULL SCAN — handle_group_live (lifecycle.rs:1366) calls article_numbers.list_groups() on every GROUP command to check whether the group is carried. list_groups executes GROUP BY group_name over the article_numbers table. With thousands of groups, this is a full index scan per GROUP command per session. Fix: use a targeted EXISTS query or check only against the session cache and refresh the cache only after a POST succeeds.
